input:
So, will AI make the average person more intelligent? No. Definitely not.

The other thing I want to unpack is the difference between understanding and knowledge.

Knowledge is power. Says the scholar.

Knowledge puffs you up, but love edifies. Says the Apostle.

AI piles knowledge on you. It knows a LOT! In fact, most of the time you can’t take in all of the knowledge, so your brain goes into overload. Knowledge means posessing information. Knowledge is good and important, but it is possible to know a lot, but not to have understanding about a subject.

Understanding is what you gain when you take the time to learn and experience a particular topic.
